name: sepia
description: Voice-preserving multilingual writing package for Japanese, English, and Spanish, with the Sepia router plus write, review, refactor, and recreate entries.

author.name: O.P.P Studio — derived from Sepia by Nanako Tsai

interface.longDescription: Write, review, refactor, or recreate Japanese, English, and Spanish prose while preserving facts, locale, register, and the author's Human Voice Profile. Review diagnoses without editing; refactor makes minimal edits; recreate rewrites from source facts and intent. Includes fiction and professional writing guidance. This skills-only plugin needs no Sepia server or account. It does not promise AI-detector evasion or certify human authorship. Independent derivative of Sepia by Nanako Tsai, under the MIT License.
defaultPrompt: Sepiaで日本語の案内文を書いてください。必要な事実と文体を先に確認してください。
Use Sepia review to diagnose this English draft without editing it. Preserve my voice and locale.
Usa Sepia refactor para revisar este texto en español con cambios mínimos, conservando mi voz y variedad regional.
